author: Ryan Daws
description:
Google Play has separated its billing and service fees for developers in the US, UK, and European Economic Area (EEA). The changes allow developers to route digital commerce through alternative payment gateways or external web domains, effective 30 June 2026. Developers can also build custom choice screens that conform to platform user experience guidelines as […]

title: Google Play splits billing fees for US and European developers
